# Android Studio

[![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-android-studio)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-android-studio)
[![npm downloads](https://img.shields.io/npm/dt/@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-android-studio)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-android-studio)

Android Studio is a **dark** CodeMirror 6 theme whose text colors all meet WCAG AA contrast.

[Open in playground](../../playground/theme-gallery/) to compare it with the other themes.

## Install

```bash
npm install @fsegurai/codemirror-theme-android-studio codemirror
```

The theme is also exported as `androidStudio` by `@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-bundle`.

## Usage

```ts
import { basicSetup, EditorView } from 'codemirror';
import { androidStudio } from '@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-android-studio';

new EditorView({
  doc: 'const answer = 42;',
  extensions: [basicSetup, androidStudio],
  parent: document.body,
});
```

| Export | Type |
|---|---|
| `androidStudio` | `Extension` |
| `androidStudioMergeStyles` | `IMergeRevertStyles` |
| `applyMergeRevertStyles` | `(styles: IMergeRevertStyles) => void` |

## Editor surfaces

Translucent colors are composited over the background, which is the color text is measured against.

| Surface | Color |
|---|---|
| Background | `#282b2e` |
| Active line | `#292c2f` |
| Selection | `#173a66` |

## Syntax colors

Resolved highlight styles for common [Lezer tags](https://lezer.codemirror.net/docs/ref/#highlight.tags) and their contrast ratio. WCAG AA requires 4.5:1 for text; the lowest ratio of this theme, over all tags, is 4.52:1 on the selection.

| Role | Tag | Color | Style | On background | On active line | On selection |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Keyword | `keyword` | `#e58f4b` | bold | 5.67:1 | 5.59:1 | 4.56:1 |
| Control keyword | `controlKeyword` | `#e58f4b` | bold | 5.67:1 | 5.59:1 | 4.56:1 |
| Operator | `operator` | `#e58f4b` | - | 5.67:1 | 5.59:1 | 4.56:1 |
| Punctuation | `punctuation` | `#a9b7c6` | - | 6.97:1 | 6.87:1 | 5.60:1 |
| Variable | `variableName` | `#b996cc` | - | 5.62:1 | 5.55:1 | 4.53:1 |
| Variable definition | `definition(variableName)` | `#b996cc` | - | 5.62:1 | 5.55:1 | 4.53:1 |
| Function call | `function(variableName)` | `#a9b7c6` | - | 6.97:1 | 6.87:1 | 5.60:1 |
| Property | `propertyName` | `#8dac7c` | - | 5.64:1 | 5.57:1 | 4.54:1 |
| Type | `typeName` | `#ffc66d` | - | 9.19:1 | 9.06:1 | 7.39:1 |
| Class | `className` | `#ffc66d` | italic | 9.19:1 | 9.06:1 | 7.39:1 |
| Namespace | `namespace` | `#b996cc` | italic | 5.62:1 | 5.55:1 | 4.53:1 |
| String | `string` | `#8dac7c` | - | 5.64:1 | 5.57:1 | 4.54:1 |
| Regular expression | `regexp` | `#8dac7c` | - | 5.64:1 | 5.57:1 | 4.54:1 |
| Number | `number` | `#79a8cd` | - | 5.62:1 | 5.55:1 | 4.52:1 |
| Boolean | `bool` | `#e58f4b` | - | 5.67:1 | 5.59:1 | 4.56:1 |
| Constant | `constant(variableName)` | `#b996cc` | - | 5.62:1 | 5.55:1 | 4.53:1 |
| Comment | `comment` | `#a3a3a3` | italic | 5.64:1 | 5.57:1 | 4.54:1 |
| Meta | `meta` | `#a3a3a3` | - | 5.64:1 | 5.57:1 | 4.54:1 |
| Tag | `tagName` | `#e8bf6a` | - | 8.20:1 | 8.08:1 | 6.59:1 |
| Attribute | `attributeName` | `#a9b7c6` | - | 6.97:1 | 6.87:1 | 5.60:1 |
| Heading | `heading` | `#ffc66d` | bold | 9.19:1 | 9.06:1 | 7.39:1 |
| Emphasis | `emphasis` | inherits `#a9b7c6` | italic | 6.97:1 | 6.87:1 | 5.60:1 |
| Strong | `strong` | inherits `#a9b7c6` | bold | 6.97:1 | 6.87:1 | 5.60:1 |
| Link | `link` | `#68a7eb` | 500 | 5.64:1 | 5.56:1 | 4.54:1 |
| URL | `url` | `#5fb566` | underline | 5.62:1 | 5.54:1 | 4.52:1 |
| Inserted | `inserted` | `#8dac7c` | - | 5.64:1 | 5.57:1 | 4.54:1 |
| Deleted | `deleted` | `#fb7d76` | - | 5.62:1 | 5.55:1 | 4.53:1 |
| Invalid | `invalid` | `#fb7d76` | underline | 5.62:1 | 5.55:1 | 4.53:1 |

## Editor UI colors

Non-text indicators need 3:1 (WCAG 1.4.11). The selection must stay distinguishable on the active line (1.15:1 or more).

| Element | Selector | Color | Measured against | Ratio | Result |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Text | `&` | `#a9b7c6` | background, active line, selection | 5.60:1 | Pass |
| Line numbers | `.cm-gutters` | `#989b9e` | gutter | 4.54:1 | Pass |
| Cursor | `.cm-cursor` | `#ffffff` | background, active line | 14.04:1 | Pass |
| Focus ring | `&.cm-focused` | `#989b9e` | background | 5.10:1 | Pass |
| Matching bracket outline | `.cm-matchingBracket` | `1px solid #4c7e68` | background, active line | 3.00:1 | Pass |
| Current search match | `.cm-searchMatch-selected` | `#375580, 1px solid #ffffff` | background (fill or outline) | 14.24:1 | Pass |
| Selection | `.cm-selectionBackground` | `#173a66` | active line | 1.23:1 | Pass |
